metadata.project: LepiLED DIY Maxi Switch (Rev 4.1 — USB-C PD Only + Dual AL8860 Buck + Hysteretic UVLO + Gold DPDT + S1-A Zero-CNC)
metadata.notes: Single source of truth for Rev 4.1 SPICE simulations, KiCad 9.0.8 schematics/PCBs, thermal verification, CAD, and UK GBP BOM. Every specification is grounded in verified PDF datasheets in datasheets/.

AL8860WT-7.package: TSOT25 (5-pin, 0.95 mm pitch, 0.68 mm nominal pads, no underside EPAD)

pinout_tsot25.1: SW (Drain of internal 40 V NDMOS switch)
pinout_tsot25.3: CTRL (Enable / analog & PWM dimming / soft-start cap; <=0.2 V OFF, >=0.25 V ON, float = 100%)
pinout_tsot25.4: SET (High-side current sense input; Rs between VIN and SET)
pinout_tsot25.5: VIN (4.5 V to 40 V supply input)

AL8860WT-7.open_led_protection: Inherent: SW pulls low, SET rises to VIN, zero overvoltage (p. 13)
AL8860WT-7.short_led_protection: Inherent: regulates switch current at nominal I_LED with reduced duty cycle (p. 13-14)

AP33771CFBZ-13-FA02.package: W-DFN3030-14 (Type A1, 3.0x3.0 mm, 0.40 mm pitch, 1.80x2.70 mm EPAD GND)

pinout.1: VOUT (VOUT monitoring & discharge via 200 Ohm series resistor)
pinout.2: PWR_EN (High-side gate drive for external 40 V N-MOSFET load switch Q1)
pinout.3: VCC (Supply input downstream of 5 mOhm shunt, 1 uF to GND)
pinout.4: ISENP (Upstream of 5 mOhm current sense resistor)
pinout.7: LED (5 V status LED D12 via 1 kOhm: 4 s breathing = VOUT ON, steady = PDO mismatch)
pinout.8: VSEL (39.0 kOhm 1% -> 20 V PDO per Table 2)
pinout.9: ISEL (82.0 kOhm 1% -> 1.0 A PDO / 1.1 A OCP per Table 2)
pinout.12: DN (NC — moisture detection waived per Table 1)
pinout.13: DP (NC — moisture detection waived per Table 1)
pinout.14: V5V (Internal 5 V LDO output, 1 uF to GND)

LM393BIDR.usage: U4A 0.90 V-hysteresis UVLO (V_ON = 17.54 V, V_OFF = 16.64 V); U4B UVLO_FAULT inverter driving Q2/Q3

DMN4035L-7.usage: Q1 single 40 V USB-C PD high-side load switch (slew-controlled via R11=6.2k, C13=47nF, R21=1M)

BSS138.usage: Q2, Q3 UVLO_FAULT pull-down clamps on U1_CTRL / U2_CTRL

B340A-13-F.usage: D9 Ch1 buck freewheel, D10 Ch2 buck freewheel
